title: Natural linear stalk morphism induced by the open adjunction unit
statement: Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be a ringed space [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism], $W$ an open subset of $X$, $x\in W$, and $j_!$ the sheafified extension-by-zero functor [def-weil-extension-by-zero-presheaf, def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification]. Fix the adjunction unit chosen by [lem-sc-derived-open-restriction-adjunction-exact]. There is a natural $\mathcal O_{X,x}$-linear morphism from the stalk functor on module sheaves on $W$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-pc-module-stalk-functor], with scalars transported by the inverse restriction-stalk ring isomorphism, to the stalk at $x$ of $j_!$. On the germ of each section $s$ on every open $V\subset W$ containing $x$, this morphism is the germ on the image of $V$ in $X$ of the section obtained by applying the chosen unit to $s$. No invertibility is asserted.

source.place: Sheaves Tag 00A7 (lemma-j-shriek-modules), (2)-(3), the unit on stalks; Tag 007Z (lemma-stalk-sheafification)

proof.text: Apply the equivalence from the slice site to W to the chosen unit, and take the additive stalk map. Compose with the additive restriction-stalk isomorphism for the extension sheaf.

Represent both a scalar and a vector on a common neighborhood in W. The unit is linear there, and the germ scalar multiplication formula shows that the composite is linear after scalar transport by the inverse restriction-stalk ring isomorphism. The inverse and forward ring comparisons cancel.

Naturality follows by checking germs, using naturality of the unit and of the additive restriction-stalk comparison. On a germ the comparison sends the restricted germ to the original germ on its open image, which gives the required formula.

theorem exists_moduleExtensionByZero_stalk_morphism (X : RingedSpace.{u}) :
    (∀ (W : Opens X) (x : X) (hx : x ∈ W),
      ∃ e : (W.sheafOfModulesEquivOver (moduleRings X)).functor ⋙
          RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor (X.restrict (Opens.isOpenEmbedding W)) ⟨x, hx⟩ ⋙
          ModuleCat.restrictScalars
            (X.toPresheafedSpace.restrictStalkIso (Opens.isOpenEmbedding W) ⟨x, hx⟩).inv.hom ⟶
        (SheafOfModules.extensionByZeroPresheaf.{u} (moduleRings X) W ⋙
          PresheafOfModules.sheafification.{u} (𝟙 (moduleRings X).obj)) ⋙
          RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X x,
        ∀ (G : SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X).over W)) (V : Opens W)
          (hV : (⟨x, hx⟩ : W) ∈ V)
          (s : ((W.sheafOfModulesEquivOver (moduleRings X)).functor.obj G).val.obj (op V)),
          (e.app G) (TopCat.Presheaf.germ (C := Ab.{u})
              (X := (X.restrict (Opens.isOpenEmbedding W)).carrier)
              ((W.sheafOfModulesEquivOver (moduleRings X)).functor.obj G).val.presheaf
              V ⟨x, hx⟩ hV s) =
            TopCat.Presheaf.germ (C := Ab.{u}) (X := X.carrier)
              ((SheafOfModules.extensionByZeroPresheaf.{u} (moduleRings X) W ⋙
                PresheafOfModules.sheafification.{u} (𝟙 (moduleRings X).obj)).obj
                  G).val.presheaf
              ((Opens.isOpenEmbedding W).isOpenMap.functor.obj V) x ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, hV, rfl⟩
              (((Classical.choice (open_restriction_adjunction_exact X W).2.2.2.2).unit.app
                G).val.app
                (op (Over.mk (homOfLE (Set.image_subset_iff.2 (fun y _ => y.2))))) s))
